iphone-6.9.description: Colony core of the red colony: both swimming pools and both racetracks whole, with the barracks, school, inns and hundreds of globs at work around them
The front at the blue colony with the Flags palette open: a blue line and a red line face each other across the centre, about 15 blue and 25 red warriors, two war flags and a lit wheat field
iphone-6.9.note: Battle slide (role changed from territory on 2026-11-24, after the round 2 review, which found it the best fight of any phone frame; no iPhone battle capture passed the two-row limit). The war flag was placed by the player at the recorded tile just before the frame; fight ground is partly fog-dimmed.

iphone-6.9.description: A different part of the colony: inns and wheat fields on the lakeshore below violet forest, busy with globs
Build palette open over the live colony beside the lake, a pool and school at work in view
Inn selected: food and fruit stock beside two Swarms, workers and a wheat field
A second map, FourSquares1: the red colony on its island beside the algae-covered sea, sand and violet forest
iphone-6.9.note: Second map: FourSquares1, an island map, from a different match than the other slots.
